name: Self-Healing Supervisor
description: Infrastructure that detects incidents, drafts a repair plan, and halts every consequential step for a named human approver. Ships as behaviour only: the buyer supplies secrets, datastore, notifications, approver identity, branding and SIEM transport.
_minModules: The buyer import graph measured 64 modules on 2026-07-26. A materially shorter walk means an entry point moved or an import style changed, and a partial payload must never ship silently.
_hostFallbacks: Bare or aliased specifiers the payload may reach but does not ship.
_knownNamingExceptions: The payload carries no build-platform naming exceptions. Keep this empty.
buyerMustSupply: SecretsProvider — reads credentials from the buyer's own vault. No environment variables are read by the payload.
SqlExecutor — executes against the buyer's own SQL datastore. DDL for supervisor_dispatch_ledger is in the integration guide.
NotificationSink — delivers approval requests to the buyer's channel (email, Slack, ServiceNow, PagerDuty).
ApproverDirectory — maps each risk category to a real named human.
HostBranding — the buyer's own name and URL. The payload carries no default brand.
SiemTransport — receives audit events as ECS-JSON or CEF.
ApiStepRunner — optional. Supply one to control how api_request repair steps execute.
@/lib/email host fallback — platform development only; enterprise deployments provide NotificationSink instead.
@/lib/engine/universalRunner host fallback — platform default only; enterprise deployments inject ApiStepRunner instead.
@/lib/supervisor/executors/owner-notifier host fallback — platform email notifier excluded from the buyer archive.
supportedPlatforms: TypeScript 5.x, non-strict and strict both compile
Any SQL datastore reachable through the buyer's SqlExecutor
Any SIEM accepting ECS-JSON or CEF over the buyer's SiemTransport
Linux and macOS build hosts; no native modules

upgradeCompatibility.policy: Within 1.x the buyer-facing interfaces are additive only.
upgradeCompatibility.rollback: The payload holds no state of its own.

knownLimitations: The build platform's name no longer appears anywhere in the payload; the release gate blocks on any reappearance.
Deployment-platform trigger ingestion sits outside the buyer import graph.
The acceptance harness has not yet been run against a buyer's real wiring.

acceptance.how: Call runAcceptanceScenario({ host }) with your own HostContext, once per risk category.
acceptance.guarantee: The consequential step is required to pause.
acceptance.evidence: The returned result is frozen and JSON-serializable.
